title: Interaction of Color
summary: Two squares are one identical computed colour that the eye reads as two; a live converge animation slides them together to dissolve the illusion.
mechanism: getComputedStyle attests both chips share one RGB value while two per-visit HSL grounds force simultaneous contrast; a transform-driven converge onto a neutral field proves sameness — a motion impossible on paper.
references: Josef Albers, Homage to the Square (1950–1976)
